name: Backend Required Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

    - name: Run security scan
      id: bandit_scan
      run: |
        source .venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

    - name: Check if changes affect backend or security
      id: check_changes
      run: |
        git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD | grep -E 'tldw_Server_API/(models|views|security)' > /dev/null && echo "::set-output name=backend_changed::true" || echo "::set-output name=backend_changed::false"
        git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD | grep -E 'tldw_Server_API/(tests|config)' > /dev/null && echo "::set-output name=security_changed::true" || echo "::set-output name=security_changed::false"

  backend:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.changed_files_count > 0 }}
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run backend tests
      run: |
        source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

  security:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.changed_files_count > 0 }}
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run security scan
      run: |
        source .venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

    - name: Review dependencies
      uses: dependabot/dependabot-core@v1
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        update-lockfiles: true
        target-branch: main

    - name: Pin dependency review action
      run: |
        echo "dependency_review_action_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Update dependency review action
      run: |
        sed -i "s|action: 'dependabot/dependabot-core'|action: 'dependabot/dependabot-core@${{ env.dependency_review_action_sha }}'" .github/workflows/security.yml
